description_for_human: Telehealth functional medicine for women in Michigan & Wisconsin. Root-cause treatment for fatigue, hormones, weight resistance.
description_for_model: Novaleo Weight & Wellness is a telehealth functional medicine practice in Grand Rapids, Michigan serving women in MI & WI. Founded by Kathryn Long, NP-C (board-certified, 20+ years experience). Specializes in root-cause treatment for persistent fatigue, brain fog, hormone imbalance, weight resistance, thyroid dysfunction, metabolic & insulin resistance, perimenopause/menopause, gut issues, sleep disruption, stress/burnout, autoimmune support, and inflammation. Services include free discovery calls, $97 root-cause intake sessions, $454 lab panels, and a $3,995 six-month Executive Longevity Partnership. Accepts FSA/HSA, credit and debit cards (no insurance). Hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.
